skill.summary: Generates comprehensive interview question sets tailored to specific job roles, including behavioral, technical, and situational questions

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of interview-question-bank skill.
- Generates comprehensive interview question sets tailored to any job role.
- Includes behavioral (STAR method), situational, technical, and culture fit questions.
- Allows customization by job title, responsibilities, experience level, and company culture.
- Provides scoring guidance and interview structure recommendations.
